1) You confirm Type II vs. excerpt + bridge letter by EOD Thu 5/20
2) Send the email address to invite to our trust portal (or note preferred transfer method)
3) We will provision a temp attestation and upload any bridge artifacts within 48 hours of portal access.

If you'd prefer a quick 15-min call to walk through the intake form, I'm free tomorrow between 11–1 PT.
